entities.name: Anthousa
entities.description: Legendary warrior of Theros, leader of Leina Tower and commander of Karametra's Council of Warriors.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: Goddess of harvests; favors Anthousa and bestowed strength on her.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms who awoke an ancient titan to kill Anthousa.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Goddess who assisted Anthousa against the titan.

entities.name: Lachrymosa
entities.description: Figure stealing children and turning them into Returned.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City that sent a force which beat Anthousa to the Lachrymosa.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: Place where Anthousa rules in Karametra's absence.

events.summary: Keranos awoke an ancient titan to kill Anthousa during a conflict with Karametra; with Nylea's help Anthousa slew it.
events.quote: With Nylea 's assistance, Anthousa managed to slay the creature.

events.summary: Karametra bestowed supernatural strength on Anthousa, who cut the titan's head from his body.
events.quote: Karametra then bestowed supernatural strength on Anthousa

relations.note: Devout worshiper and commander of her Council of Warriors.
relations.quote: A devout worshiper of Karametra , Anthousa serves as Leina Tower's leader

relations.note: Sent a titan to kill her.
relations.quote: Keranos, knowing of Karametra's favor for her close advisor, awoke an ancient titan to kill the warrior.
commander of the goddess's Council of Warriors
